object_description: undulating curvilinear building winding around a central green space
design_condition: the building undulates around a central green space with wide openings breaking any sense of enclosure, autonomous from the fragmented context rather than resolving it

positive: The central location laid out as a green space that residents can colonise is very appealing
Any sense of enclosure is broken by the wide openings in the building
The proposed setting is resolutely different from the teaching buildings and offers a real break in the student day
The proposed urban form with its autonomy from the fragmented context is not uninteresting
It plays with the current indefiniteness without aggravating it
Foundations, structure, energy and sustainable development have been addressed and dealt with
The large windows are given a welcome programmatic component in the second tower
The idea of students living together takes on an original form and a signature of its own on an urban scale
negative: The long curvilinear corridors are perceived as oppressive
The claim of doing without joints on a structure of this size is not demonstrated
Facade elements and the large through openings penalise a project slightly above the financial target
The scale of the construction is imposing in relation to the existing buildings
It is not certain the sinuosity of the facade will mitigate this jump in scale
The centre of the composition has closed in on itself compared to the first round
The ground floor is not very permeable and the plan contradicts the transparency of the renders
The cross-sectional position of the sports hall creates an unfortunate topography like an obstacle
The central corridor typology is poor and uninviting
The curvature induces a labyrinthine effect
The large openings cannot be crossed and isolate parts of the building from each other
The jury remains sceptical about the spatial qualities of the student room
Generous openings in the plan turn out to be small openings in the perspectives
The constructive section shows the same discrepancy with the images
The transcription of use value at the intimate, lived-in scale did not convince
Such an exceptional form could have produced more assertive spatial qualities
